title: operator_inbox's proofs and probe reach the dashboard and the map only as the commands he types
intention: operator_inbox's proofs and its probe one_status_everywhere import codemother's dashboard and the harbor master's device and register to render the three reports: test_one_status_everywhere.py:80,81,82, test_operator_inbox.py:295, probes/one_status_everywhere.py:57,58. A tool's proofs measure the tool (RULE 1). What a device exposes is its command and its bus; the fixture halves now berth at their owners (cbbb651f4552, 0c6f774d9ad8, PROVED today).
why: Measured 2026-11-11: encapsulation_holds names cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_one_status_everywhere.py:80,81,82, cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py:295 and cairn/tools/operator_inbox/probes/one_status_everywhere.py:57,58. RULE 1: a component talks to another only through its public interface.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 2.3.7.1 (a device's public interface is the bus plus any tool it publishes); outline 17.13.1.
how: test_one_status_everywhere.py: the fixture teeth keep only the inbox side (the inbox's rows wear the reader's label; the header sums with no other, in the reader's count and order); the prose-standing and crossing-patch teeth leave with their PROVES keys 6 and 7 (held at cbbb651f4552); the live teeth read `cairn codemother show dashboard` and `cairn harbor_master show map open` by subprocess; which components stand in prose is read off the map's FINDING lines instead of register(). test_operator_inbox.py's idea/intention-count tooth reads the dashboard by `cairn codemother show dashboard`. The probe renders the dashboard and the map by the same two commands. New proof cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox_proofs_measure_only_operator_inbox.py carries the sieve and forbidden-module teeth.

clauses.claim: no RULE 1 breach from a file under cairn/tools/operator_inbox lands on a device
operator_inbox's proofs and probe name no module of codemother or the harbor master

decisions.text: D1: operator_inbox reads the dashboard and the map through the commands he types; the fixture halves berth with their owners.
